checks.claim: Composite DTM covers about 99% of England.
Surface objects are removed from DSM to create terrain-only DTM.
Terrain production includes bespoke algorithms and manual editing.
Composite combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys.
Where surveys repeat, newest best-resolution data is used.
Resampled source data uses bilinear interpolation before merge.
2022 composite contains surveys from 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022.
Metadata index identifies which survey contributed at a location.
WCS is available for numeric raster extraction; WMS remains visual/preview oriented.
